description: This file contains functions for extracting, processing, and applying translations to segments of markdown text, particularly focusing on parsing markdown documents, identifying translatable blocks, and handling translations.

methods.name: extractSegments
methods.description: Extracts translatable segments from a markdown body, identifying text blocks outside code and HTML blocks, and computing segment IDs and hashes.

methods.name: blockParent
methods.description: Finds the parent node that is considered translatable from a given AST node.

methods.name: isTranslatableBlock
methods.description: Determines if a given AST node is a translatable block type (paragraph, heading, list item).

methods.name: applyTranslations
methods.description: Replaces original segments in the body text with their translated equivalents based on provided segments.
